essence: The practitioner possesses the power to disturb the worlds through mere vision.
Performing an oblation with honey-anointed substances pleases Kālakarṇī.
The mantrin must constantly remember the goddess who produces various wonders.
Once accomplished, Mahābhayā bestows an elixir upon the practitioner.
The elixir frees the practitioner from aging signs and disease.
